Interface JMSProducerSessionConfiguration

@ConfigurationProperties("micronaut.jms.producer-sessions") public interface JMSProducerSessionConfiguration
The configuration of the sessions that producer methods send with.

5.2.0

  • Method Details

    • isEnabled

      @Bindable(defaultValue="true") boolean isEnabled()
      Returns:
      Whether producer methods reuse sessions, on one connection of each connection factory. When disabled, each send takes a connection from the pool and opens a session. Defaults to true.

    • getMaxIdle

      @Min(0L) @Bindable(defaultValue="8") @Min(0L) int getMaxIdle()
      Returns:
      The maximum number of idle sessions kept for each connection factory and session mode. While sends wait for a session, released sessions are kept for them up to getMaxActive(); the idle sessions above this number are closed once no send waits. Defaults to 8.

    • getMaxActive

      @Min(1L) @Bindable(defaultValue="32") @Min(1L) int getMaxActive()
      Returns:
      The maximum number of sessions of each connection factory that sends use at once, of all session modes. When all of them are borrowed, a send waits up to getMaxWait() for one to be released. Defaults to 32.
      Since:
      5.2.0

    • getMaxWait

      @Bindable(defaultValue="10s") Duration getMaxWait()
      Returns:
      How long a send waits for a session when getMaxActive() sessions are borrowed, after which the send fails. Defaults to 10 seconds.
      Since:
      5.2.0
